mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past three months signals robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where RSAFS shows sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals a weakening supply chain, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2% signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a robust demand environment, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a late-cycle expansion regime.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 declines by more than 1% QoQ during a late-cycle expansion.
